scripts.docker:run: docker run -d --platform linux/amd64 --name starbound-local -p 21025:21025/tcp -v starbound-data:/opt/starbound --env-file .env starbound-dedicated:latest
scripts.docker: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:run
scripts.stop: docker stop starbound-local 2>/dev/null; docker rm -f starbound-local 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.setup: flyctl apps create starbound-server && flyctl volumes create starbound_data --size 10 --region ord --yes
